verdict.rationale: Semgrep's core CLI scanning runs locally and does not upload code by default (semgrep-gh-2), which indirectly limits data being sent anywhere including for AI training, but there is no explicit policy or setting addressing whether Semgrep's own AI features (AI-Powered Detection, Semgrep Assistant) use customer code for model training or how to opt out. missing for 10: explicit AI-training data-use policy/statement, opt-out control for AI-powered features, independent confirmation of data handling for cloud-based AI Assistant.
